intro.text: A herd-dwelling Rosharan shellbeast, smaller than a chull, raised for its gemheart.

description.text: Its cloudy amethyst gemheart is about an inch long and can be used to Soulcast bronze.
Azish farmers raise numul in large numbers. Their meat is edible, and ancient humans hunted the herds.

items.text: In a vision of the day of the Oathpact, Dalinar saw soldiers butcher a numul without recognizing the gemheart's value.
